"""Publish completed CPU draft evidence; no neural/sensor/GPU work."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import shutil
import time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import psutil

REPO = pathlib.Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT = REPO / '.cache/quality-20261107/V178-phase-evidence-trial-v1'
ADMISSION = REPO / '.cache/quality-20261107/V178-phase-evidence-admission-v1'
V175 = REPO / '.cache/quality-20261107/V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2'


def read(path):
    return json.loads(pathlib.Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    path = pathlib.Path(path).absolute()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(2**20), b''):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=digest.hexdigest())


def save(path, value):
    with pathlib.Path(path).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


def live(owner):
    process = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
    assert process.create_time() == owner['created']
    assert process.status() not in ['zombie', 'dead']
    return process


def source(path):
    return dict(ref(path), text=pathlib.Path(path).read_text())


def main():
    os_owner = dict(pid=453410, created=1794113512.6)
    controller = live(os_owner)
    assert controller.nice() == 10 and controller.cpu_affinity() == [4, 5]
    assert not any('libtorch' in item.path or 'libcudart' in item.path
                   for item in controller.memory_maps())
    draft = read(ROOT / 'draft-v1.json')
    assert draft['status'] == 'CPU-draft-actual-warmstart-verified-awaiting-CUDA-admission'
    assert len(draft['frozen_files']) == 713 and len(draft['inputs']) == 9
    for path, digest in draft['frozen_files'].items():
        assert ref(path)['sha256'] == digest
    for binding in draft['inputs']:
        assert ref(binding['path']) == binding
    sources = []
    for relative in ['scripts/train_phase_evidence_trial.py',
                     'scripts/phase_evidence_training_state.py',
                     'scripts/render_phase_evidence_trial.py',
                     'tests/test_phase_evidence_training_state.py']:
        path = REPO / relative
        frozen = pathlib.Path(draft['work']) / relative
        assert path.read_bytes() == frozen.read_bytes()
        sources.append(source(path))
    for arm, parameters, tensors in [('control', 2088906, 141), ('evidence', 2092026, 142)]:
        proof = draft['CPU_warmstart_proof'][arm]
        assert proof['initial_updates'] == 900
        assert proof['Adam_clocks']['network'] == dict(tensors=141, states=141, steps=[900.0])
        assert proof['Adam_clocks']['adapter']['states'] == 0
        assert proof['trainable_parameters'] == parameters and proof['trainable_tensors'] == tensors
        assert proof['EMA_tensors'] == tensors
        assert all(proof[k] for k in ['original_moments_exact', 'network_EMA_exact',
                                      'new_adapter_has_no_Adam_state', 'adapter_EMA_starts_zero'])
    assert '13 passed' in draft['state_CPU_tests']['text']
    assert ref(draft['state_CPU_tests']['path']) == {k: draft['state_CPU_tests'][k]
                                                    for k in ['path', 'sha256']}
    baseline = read(V175 / 'plan-v1.json')
    assert len(baseline['prior_neural_hashes']) == 96
    for name, digest in baseline['prior_neural_hashes'].items():
        assert ref(REPO / 'src/demosaic' / name)['sha256'] == digest
    neural_sources = list((REPO / 'src/demosaic').glob('*.py'))
    assert len(neural_sources) == 97
    for path in neural_sources:
        assert path.read_bytes() == (pathlib.Path(draft['work']) / 'src/demosaic' / path.name).read_bytes()
    post = read(V175 / 'postprocess-inputs-v1.json')
    assert len(post['helpers']) == 18
    for binding in post['helpers']:
        assert ref(binding['path']) == binding
    entry = read(ROOT / 'frozen-entry-readiness-v1.json')
    fixture = read(ROOT / 'renderer-fixture-verification-v1.json')
    assert entry['status'].startswith('pass-') and not entry['CUDA_initialized']
    assert not entry['Torch_imported_by_rejected_prepare'] and not entry['training_claim_or_launch']
    assert fixture['status'] == 'pass-renderer-layout-fixture-only-no-V178-quality-evaluation'
    assert fixture['figures'] == fixture['all_headers_marked_fixture'] == 72
    assert fixture['triplets'] == 24 and fixture['sheets'] == 18
    assert fixture['new_method_crop_RGB_channels_compared_against_independent_display'] == 16588800
    assert fixture['actual_new_model_forwards'] == 0
    for proof in [entry, fixture]:
        assert proof['draft'] == ref(ROOT / 'draft-v1.json')
        assert ref(proof['source']['path']) == {k: proof['source'][k] for k in ['path', 'sha256']}
    seal = read(ROOT / 'controller-source-v1.json')
    assert ref(seal['source']['path']) == seal['source']
    assert pathlib.Path(seal['source']['path']).read_text() == seal['text']
    assert seal['draft'] == ref(ROOT / 'draft-v1.json')
    launch = read(ROOT / 'controller-launch-v1.json')
    assert launch['owner'] == os_owner and read(ROOT / 'controller-owner-v1.json') == os_owner
    state = read(ROOT / 'controller-status-v1.json')
    assert state['status'] == 'waiting-for-CUDA-admission-watch-owner'
    admission_owner = read(ADMISSION / 'watch-launch-v1.json')['owner']
    assert state['target'] == admission_owner
    live(admission_owner)
    training_owner = read(V175 / 'train-launch-v1.json')['owner']
    watcher_owner = read(V175 / 'completion-watch-launch-v1.json')['owner']
    live(training_owner)
    live(watcher_owner)
    for name in ['plan-v1.json', 'control-train.claim', 'evidence-train.claim', 'review.claim',
                 'control-train-launch-v1.json', 'evidence-train-launch-v1.json',
                 'review-launch-v1.json', 'scores-v1.json', 'figures-v1.json',
                 'controller-failure-v1.json']:
        assert not (ROOT / name).exists(), name
    assert not (ADMISSION / 'admission-result-v1.json').exists()
    assert not (ADMISSION / 'admission.claim').exists()
    audit_path = REPO / 'docs/results/v175-four-pass-boundary-audit-v1.json'
    audit = read(audit_path)
    assert audit['status'].startswith('pass-real-row5000')
    assert audit['FP32_loss_totals_checked'] == 3600 and audit['maximum_loss_total_difference'] == 0
    assert audit['actual_Adam_states'] == 141 and audit['actual_Adam_step'] == 4500
    for key in ['journal_prefix', 'event_journal_prefix']:
        prefix = audit[key]
        with pathlib.Path(prefix['path']).open('rb') as stream:
            data = stream.read(prefix['bytes'])
        assert len(data) == prefix['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == prefix['sha256']
    observed = dict(
        recorded_local=datetime.datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat(),
        observed_unix_UTC=time.time(), controller_owner=os_owner,
        controller_status=state, controller_RSS_bytes=controller.memory_info().rss,
        controller_nice=controller.nice(), controller_CPU_affinity=controller.cpu_affinity(),
        controller_has_Torch_or_CUDA_libraries=False,
        CUDA_admission_watcher_owner=admission_owner,
        CUDA_admission_watcher_status=read(ADMISSION / 'watch-status-v1.json'),
        V175_training_owner=training_owner, V175_training_status=read(V175 / 'train-status-v1.json'),
        V175_completion_watcher_owner=watcher_owner,
        V175_completion_watcher_status=read(V175 / 'completion-watch-status-v1.json'),
        available_GiB=dict(RAM=psutil.virtual_memory().available/2**30,
                           local=shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free/2**30,
                           external=shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free/2**30),
        scope='Process liveness, statuses and free space are timestamp-specific observations.')
    public = REPO / 'docs/results/v178-matched-trial-CPU-draft-v1.json'
    save(public, dict(
        status='pass-completed-CPU-draft-state-checks-frozen-entry-and-layout-fixture-awaiting-admission',
        draft_binding=ref(ROOT/'draft-v1.json'), draft=draft, implementation_sources=sources,
        frozen_entry_readiness=entry, renderer_layout_fixture_verification=fixture,
        controller_source_seal=seal, controller_launch=launch, publication_observation=observed,
        V175_four_pass_checkpoint_audit=ref(audit_path),
        actual_new_V178_neural_forwards=0, actual_V178_trial_optimizer_updates=0,
        actual_V178_trial_GPU_launches=0, actual_V178_quality_rows=0,
        actual_real_checkpoint_CPU_loads_in_draft=1, CPU_state_tests=13,
        CPU_state_tests_scope='Small toy modules perform actual AdamW updates to test clocks/storage/EMA/restore. No actual matching-module update or forward.',
        fixture_viewing='One explicitly marked fixture triplet viewed for layout only; no V178 model-quality viewing.',
        scope='No model quality gain. The waiting controller schedules actual trial only after successful terminal CUDA admission; no training plan/claims/results yet. Both protected scenes and all original evidence remain unchanged. No original/remote-source work.',
        publisher=source(__file__)))
    docs = [REPO/p for p in ['README.md', 'docs/phase-evidence-training.md',
            'docs/phase-evidence-matching.md', 'docs/fresh-noise-matching.md', 'docs/index.md',
            'docs/research.md', 'docs/experiments.md',
            'diary/2026-11-07-20-45-04-phase-evidence-matched-training-draft.md']]
    verification = REPO / 'docs/results/v178-matched-trial-publication-verification-v1.json'
    count = 0
    for path in docs:
        for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
            if link.startswith(('http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', '#')):
                continue
            target = (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve()
            assert target.exists() or target == verification, (path, link)
            count += 1
    save(verification, dict(
        status='pass-frozen-draft-live-CPU-controller-source-state-fixture-prefix-and-document-checks',
        recorded_local=observed['recorded_local'], summary=ref(public),
        documents=[ref(path) for path in docs], local_links_checked=count,
        frozen_files_checked=713, immutable_inputs_checked=9,
        current_neural_files_exact_frozen=97, original_V175_neural_files_unchanged=96,
        sealed_V175_helpers_unchanged=18, CPU_state_tests=13,
        actual_checkpoint_clocks_and_EMA_verified=True, fixture_only_figures=72,
        fixture_only_triplets=24, fixture_only_new_method_RGB_channels_checked=16588800,
        V175_four_pass_audit=ref(audit_path), V175_audit_immutable_prefixes_checked=2,
        controller_owner=os_owner, V175_training_owner=training_owner,
        CUDA_admission_watcher_owner=admission_owner, V175_completion_watcher_owner=watcher_owner,
        new_GPU_calls=0, new_trial_updates=0,
        scope='Publication verification only; no checkpoint or model load, no neural/sensor/GPU work. Actual trial and quality remain pending.',
        source=source(__file__)))
    print('PASS CPU draft, frozen713/input9, neural97/old96/helper18, fixture72/triplet24, controller453410, links',count, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
